sections.heading: Triple Integrals, Cylindrical & Spherical Coordinates Practice Exercises

questions.q: Evaluate \( \iiint_B x y z\,dV \) over the box \( B=[0,3]\times[0,1]\times[0,3] \).
questions.answer: Iterate: \( \int\limits_{0}^{3}\int\limits_{0}^{1}\int\limits_{0}^{3} x y z\, dx\, dy\, dz \) \( = \) \( \frac{81}{8} \).

questions.q: Evaluate \( \iiint_B x + y + z\,dV \) over the box \( B=[0,3]\times[0,2]\times[0,1] \).
questions.answer: Iterate: \( \int\limits_{0}^{1}\int\limits_{0}^{2}\int\limits_{0}^{3} \left(x + y + z\right)\, dx\, dy\, dz \) \( = \) \( 18 \).

questions.q: Evaluate \( \iiint_B x y z\,dV \) over the box \( B=[0,2]\times[0,1]\times[0,2] \).
questions.answer: Iterate: \( \int\limits_{0}^{2}\int\limits_{0}^{1}\int\limits_{0}^{2} x y z\, dx\, dy\, dz \) \( = \) \( 2 \).

questions.q: Evaluate \( \iiint_B y z^{2}\,dV \) over the box \( B=[0,1]\times[0,1]\times[0,3] \).
questions.answer: Iterate: \( \int\limits_{0}^{3}\int\limits_{0}^{1}\int\limits_{0}^{1} y z^{2}\, dx\, dy\, dz \) \( = \) \( \frac{9}{2} \).

questions.q: Evaluate \( \iiint_B x^{2} z\,dV \) over the box \( B=[0,1]\times[0,1]\times[0,3] \).
questions.answer: Iterate: \( \int\limits_{0}^{3}\int\limits_{0}^{1}\int\limits_{0}^{1} x^{2} z\, dx\, dy\, dz \) \( = \) \( \frac{3}{2} \).

questions.q: Evaluate \( \iiint_B x y + z\,dV \) over the box \( B=[0,1]\times[0,1]\times[0,3] \).
questions.answer: Iterate: \( \int\limits_{0}^{3}\int\limits_{0}^{1}\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left(x y + z\right)\, dx\, dy\, dz \) \( = \) \( \frac{21}{4} \).

questions.q: Evaluate \( \iiint_B x y + z\,dV \) over the box \( B=[0,1]\times[0,3]\times[0,3] \).
questions.answer: Iterate: \( \int\limits_{0}^{3}\int\limits_{0}^{3}\int\limits_{0}^{1} \left(x y + z\right)\, dx\, dy\, dz \) \( = \) \( \frac{81}{4} \).

questions.q: Evaluate \( \iiint_B x + y + z\,dV \) over the box \( B=[0,3]\times[0,3]\times[0,1] \).
questions.answer: Iterate: \( \int\limits_{0}^{1}\int\limits_{0}^{3}\int\limits_{0}^{3} \left(x + y + z\right)\, dx\, dy\, dz \) \( = \) \( \frac{63}{2} \).
